import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
i=G['Demo pair 3 input']; o=G['Demo pair 3 output']
diff=[(r,c,o[r][c]) for r in range(26) for c in range(29) if i[r][c]!=o[r][c]]
# tile centers: interior cells
tiles=[]
for r in range(1,25,6):
    for c in range(1,27,6):
        tiles.append((r,c,i[r][c]))
print(tiles)
# For each diff cell, find nearest tile(s) in each direction
for r,c,vv in sorted(diff):
    up=[(rr,cc) for rr,cc,_ in tiles if rr<r and abs(cc-c)<=1]
    dn=[(rr,cc) for rr,cc,_ in tiles if rr>r and abs(cc-c)<=1]
    lf=[(rr,cc) for rr,cc,_ in tiles if cc<c and abs(rr-r)<=1]
    rt=[(rr,cc) for rr,cc,_ in tiles if cc>c and abs(rr-r)<=1]
    print((r,c,vv),'up',up[-1:],'dn',dn[0:1],'lf',lf[-1:],'rt',rt[0:1])

        d=min((max(0, r-(f[0]+h-1), (f[0]+h-1)-r, max(0,c-(f[1]+h-1)), (f[1]+h-1)-c, max(0,r-(f[0]), (f[0])-r), max(0,c-(f[1]), (f[1])-c)) for f in F)

# Clean frame finder: square ring border b, interior uniform m!=b, maximal (no larger ring with same b containing it)
def find_frames(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); out=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            for h in range(3,min(H-r+1,W-c+1)+2):
                if g[r][c]==0: continue
                # check border & interior uniformity
                if not all(g[r+i][c+j]==g[r][c] for i in range(h) for j in range(h) if i==0 or j==0 or i==h-1 or j==h-1): break
                mi=g[r+1][c+1]
                if not all(g[r+i][c+j]==mi for i in range(1,h-1) for j in range(1,h-1)): break
                if len({g[r+i][c+j] for i in range(1,h-1) for j in range(1,h-1)})!=1: break
                if mi==0: break
                # maximal: no larger same-b ring contains this block fully
                cont=False
                for hh in range(h+1,min(H-r+1,W-c+1)+2):
                    if not all(g[x][y]==g[r][c] for x in range(r,r+hh) for y in range(c,c+hh)): pass
                    elif all(g[x][y]==g[r][c] for x in range(r,r+hh) for y in range(c,c+hh)) and True: pass
                    else:
                        big=bnd=all(g[x][y]==g[r][c] for x in range(r,r+hh) for y in range(c,c+hh))
                        inter=all(g[x][y]==g[r+1][c+1] for x in range(r+1,r+hh-1) for y in range(c+1,c+hh-1))
                        if big and inter: cont=True
                if cont: continue
                out.append((r,c,h,g[r+1][c+1],g[r][c]))
    return out

def restore(grid, Ph, Pw):
